# Telemetry feature lineage

Cutoff: 2026-01-01T00:10:00Z (excluded).
History: 5 minutes; lower boundary included.
Time is based on information availability, not observation time.

## COUNT(samples)

The number of all instances of "samples" for each "asset_id" in "assets".

Inputs: samples.sample_id

## MAX(samples.latency_ms)

The maximum of the "latency_ms" of all instances of "samples" for each "asset_id" in "assets".

Inputs: samples.latency_ms

## MEAN(samples.latency_ms)

The average of the "latency_ms" of all instances of "samples" for each "asset_id" in "assets".

Inputs: samples.latency_ms
